validation_summary: All 15 generated settlement mask and preview outputs verified. Panapalli parameters refined to 120 threshold with expanded box focus. Comparison sheet script configured at scripts/create_comparison_sheet.py.

panapalli_refinement.objective_effect: Incorporates darker clay-tile rooftops and adjacent dwellings along the central village road spine without expanding into surrounding agricultural step terraces.

settlement_evaluations.name: Kondanur
settlement_evaluations.visual_inspection: Passable. Accurately segments central road junction cluster, northern homestead, and western spur. Partial over-segmentation on bright dirt road sections. Forest and terraced fields successfully suppressed.

settlement_evaluations.name: Pudur
settlement_evaluations.visual_inspection: Good. Clearly isolates the enclosed northern residential/farm compound within the ring road and southern road junction structures. Surrounding forest canopy and terraced slopes cleanly excluded.

settlement_evaluations.name: Panapalli
settlement_evaluations.visual_inspection: Previously under-segmented at 135 threshold (only bright metal roofs captured). Refined to threshold 120 with expanded focus box to incorporate darker tiled dwellings along village spine.

settlement_evaluations.name: Kandivalli / Kandivazhi
settlement_evaluations.visual_inspection: Fair. Successfully captures western hillside hamlet and eastern roadside settlement. Moderate over-segmentation on pale dry soil patches along unpaved road segments.

settlement_evaluations.name: Sembukarai
settlement_evaluations.visual_inspection: Good. Accurately delineates compound clusters along State Highway 164 (Thadagam Road). Watermark and mountain canopy cleanly suppressed.

remaining_segmentation_limitations: Unpaved roads with pale, dry soil have spectral signatures close to weathered building roofs, causing minor road spur inclusion in Kondanur and Kandivazhi.
Dry agricultural fallow clearings occasionally register as non-vegetated high-reflectance regions without multi-spectral infrared bands.
Sub-meter building boundaries merge into single cluster blobs due to necessary morphological closing operations.
geographic_calibration_status: NONE. The screenshots are raw RGB captures without embedded affine transform matrices, world files (.pgw/.tfw), or sub-meter ground control points. Derived polygons remain in pixel coordinates and are strictly withheld from geographic projection.
